title: Regime-timeline blocking gates (carry_decay_v1 + abstention/occupancy/upside)
summary: A PROPOSED set of BLOCKING timeline gates for the open_macro_v03 regime candidate. This artifact does NOT ratify itself: until status becomes 'ratified' with a named quant_owner, the harness COMPUTES and REPORTS these judgments as advisory only and blocks nothing. The gate bounds must be ratified BEFORE any candidate is judged against them.

gate_semantics.min_fresh_valid_rate_36m: At least this fraction of the trailing 36 monthly decision rows must be FRESH-VALID (a real, non-carried consumable decision). Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.fresh_valid_rate.rolling_36m. Bounds the model's tendency to abstain for multi-year stretches.
gate_semantics.max_abstention_streak_months: The longest run of consecutive non-valid (abstaining) months must not exceed this. Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.max_abstention_streak_months.
gate_semantics.max_carry_age_months: The longest run of consecutive CARRIED (gated) months following a valid seed must not exceed this. This is the SAME bound the carry_decay_v1 runtime cap enforces (MAX_CARRY_MONTHS = 3): past age 3 the consumable degrades to the mandate-tilted CENTER book (carry_expired). Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.max_carry_age_months.
gate_semantics.max_same_quadrant_run_months: The longest run in the SAME consumable quadrant over the carry-filled latched chain must not exceed this. Directly bounds the 2023-02 -> 2026 contraction anchor the audit flagged. Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.max_same_quadrant_run_months.
gate_semantics.min_upside_capture_bull_year: In every BULL calendar year (SPY total return > bull_year_spy_return_threshold), the strategy must capture at least this fraction of SPY's return. The gate's measured value is the MINIMUM upside_capture across bull years in the primary window; a year where SPY did NOT clear the bull threshold is not judged (down/flat years are a downside-capture question out of this gate's scope). Judged on upside_capture_by_calendar_year.

rationale: The phase0q_003 stress_gate_semantics_amendment (ratified 2026-07-02) correctly stopped penalizing intended per-window abstention by making consumable_position_coverage the blocking stress metric, but it reclassified fresh_decision_rate / abstention_rate as diagnostics_not_gating and the acceptance envelope stayed risk-only (turnover / MDD / vol / worst-5d / fold stability; no return target). The joint effect: a decision chain that abstained 43 of 66 months (2021-2026) and carried a single 2023-02 contraction book for years reported 100% consumable coverage, near-zero turnover, low vol and low MDD -- i.e. the multi-year defensive carry was the OPTIMUM of the envelope. These gates restore a blocking judgment on the timeline itself: fresh-valid density, abstention streak, carry age, single-quadrant occupancy and benchmark-relative upside in bull years. Bounds are proposals for quant_owner ratification; they are deliberately loose (e.g. 36m fresh-valid >= 0.40, carry age <= 3) rather than tuned to any CAGR/Sharpe target, consistent with the freeze rule to calibrate abstention/flip/duration behaviour and NEVER against CAGR.

amends.effect_when_ratified: Re-elevates fresh_decision_rate and abstention_rate (and, via the timeline gates, carry age and single-quadrant occupancy) from diagnostics_not_gating back to BLOCKING at the run level. consumable_position_coverage remains the per-stress-window blocking metric from phase0q_003; these timeline gates are an ADDITIONAL run-level layer, not a repeal of the phase0q_003 carry semantics.
amends.does_not_amend: The frozen model parameters (confidence floor 0.70, axis weights, hysteresis, 10y robust baseline) are NOT touched by this policy. Recalibration is a separate future experiment; this artifact only proposes the acceptance bounds.

requires: quant_owner ratification (status -> ratified, ratified_by named, decision_date set)

the carry_decay_v1 runtime cap deploy + a governance-sanctioned re-pin of the decision-chain module closure and a DB-schema evolution able to persist carry_expired / center-book allocations (the current open_macro_v03_decisions/allocations CHECK constraints admit only the four quadrant labels and the compressed_50 book)
activation.until_ratified: advisory_only: the harness computes judge_timeline_gates and attaches it to the gate report with mode='advisory'; it blocks nothing and does not enter gates_overall_base_cost.
